blocks.text: Pacific Douglas homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Pacific Douglas, September 2026. Detached houses: 39 listed at month end and 6 sold in September, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 25 listed at month end and 4 sold in September, a sales ratio of 16% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 13 over 4 months against an average of 35.2 listed, about 10.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 6 sold. condos and townhomes sold 11 over 4 months against an average of 21.2 listed, about 7.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 6 sold.
